rel: The kings worshipped Ahura Mazda; the empire tolerated the cults of its peoples.
periods.glance: Achaemenid Empire, 550 BC to 451 BC: absolute monarchy. About 16 million to 35 million people in 500 BC (estimates differ). Religion recorded on Wikidata: Zoroastrianism. Leaders: Cyrus the Great, Cambyses II, Bardiya and others.
